slides.headline: Is the Chanel 25 the new It bag?
Chanel's 2025 everyday line
slides.body: Softer, lighter, less structured than the Classic Flap. Built to be carried, not babied.

slides.headline: Since 2019 the lines take their birth year
slides.body: The 19. The 22. The 25. It's a year, not a size.

slides.headline: Two different jobs
bullets: Classic Flap: structured, formal, the one you protect
The 25: soft, casual, a bag for the actual day

slides.headline: New line, thin resale supply
slides.body: Asking prices move week to week. We won't quote a number that's stale by the time you read it. The live range, dated and sourced, is on the page. An estimate of the market, not an appraisal of one bag.
